tests.reason: Untestable (no way): WezTerm 20240203-110809-5046fc22 has no OSC 633 parser, so the sequence is dropped without a target-state reading, a report or a non-debug log. Read tag 20240203-110809-5046fc22 (5046fc225992db6ba2ef8812743fadfdfe4b184a): termwiz/src/escape/osc.rs:409 is the OSC command table and carries SetHyperlink = "8" and FinalTermSemanticPrompt = "133" (:439) with no 633 entry — the file has zero occurrences of 633 — dispatched at :312,326-327 and parsed at :627-696. The macOS build runs this same termwiz parser (window/src/os/macos, all eight .rs files, carries no OSC handling of its own and names no semantic state), the mux protocol (mux/src/lib.rs, 1441 lines) has zero "semantic" and no unhandled-OSC verb, and the CLI at this tag reads no prompt state (wezterm/src/cli/get_text.rs:34,86-87 prints text or colour/style escapes only). macOS additionally offers no default-launch log surface for dropped OSCs.
